benefits.name: Social Security retirement
benefits.benefit: Monthly earned retirement benefit; claiming age affects the lifetime payment.
benefits.value: Individual SSA earnings-record estimate; not a flat grant.
benefits.income: No general means test; earnings test can reduce payments before full retirement age.
benefits.residency: Insured work record, generally 10 years; citizenship/residency rules apply.
benefits.combine: Coordinate with spouse/survivor entitlement; benefits are not simply added. Retirement income affects means-tested programs.
benefits.apply: Request an estimate and apply online or by phone up to four months before the chosen start.
benefits.docs: Identity, birth and work/earnings information; SSA may request additional evidence.
benefits.status_detail: Administrator publishes the program; individual availability and approval are not guaranteed.
caveats: Full retirement age varies by birth year; delayed retirement increases stop at 70. Age 67 or 70 is not a new separate grant.

benefits.name: Social Security spouse and divorced-spouse benefits
benefits.benefit: Benefits based on a qualifying spouse or former spouse’s insured record.
benefits.value: Individual SSA calculation.
benefits.income: Earnings rules may apply before full retirement age.
benefits.residency: Divorced-spouse pathway generally requires marriage of 10 years, unmarried status and age 62; additional conditions apply.
benefits.combine: Deemed-filing rules can require applications for both retirement and spouse benefits; not two full benefits.
benefits.apply: Ask SSA to compare own-record and family entitlement.
benefits.status_detail: Administrator publishes the program; individual availability and approval are not guaranteed.
caveats: Fields marked not published were not established in the reviewed sources; this is not proof that the administrator has no rule.

benefits.name: Social Security survivors benefits
benefits.benefit: Monthly support for eligible surviving spouses, former spouses, children and dependent parents.
benefits.value: Individual calculation based on deceased worker’s record.
benefits.min_age: 60 for surviving spouse; 50 with qualifying disability; younger child-in-care exceptions.
benefits.income: Earnings test may apply before full retirement age.
benefits.residency: Marriage, remarriage, dependency and insured-record requirements; former marriage generally 10 years.
benefits.combine: Generally receive the higher applicable benefit, not full own retirement plus full survivors benefit. Different claiming strategies may apply.
benefits.apply: Telephone SSA for an appointment; survivor claims are not filed online.
benefits.status_detail: Administrator publishes the program; individual availability and approval are not guaranteed.
caveats: Fields marked not published were not established in the reviewed sources; this is not proof that the administrator has no rule.

benefits.name: Social Security lump-sum death payment
benefits.benefit: One-time payment to an eligible surviving spouse or child.
benefits.min_age: No general minimum; qualifying relationship required.
benefits.income: not published
benefits.residency: Rhode Island residents, including Jamestown, subject to program criteria.
benefits.combine: Separate from monthly survivors benefits; other burial programs may have reimbursement restrictions.
benefits.apply: Contact SSA to establish eligibility.
benefits.deadlines: Generally claim within two years of death.
benefits.status_detail: Administrator publishes the program; individual availability and approval are not guaranteed.
caveats: Fields marked not published were not established in the reviewed sources; this is not proof that the administrator has no rule.

benefits.name: Social Security Disability Insurance
benefits.benefit: Monthly earned disability insurance; potential dependent benefits.
benefits.value: not published
benefits.min_age: Working-age insured workers; disabled-adult-child pathways have separate rules.
benefits.income: Work activity/earnings rules apply; not a household poverty test.
benefits.residency: Sufficient insured work and SSA disability criteria; qualifying disability generally expected to last at least a year or result in death.
benefits.combine: SSI may supplement a small SSDI payment if financially eligible; other public disability payments can affect SSDI.
benefits.apply: Apply with work history and medical evidence.
benefits.docs: Medical providers, conditions, treatment and work history.
benefits.status_detail: Administrator publishes the program; individual availability and approval are not guaranteed.
caveats: Fields marked not published were not established in the reviewed sources; this is not proof that the administrator has no rule.

benefits.name: Supplemental Security Income
benefits.benefit: Means-tested monthly income for people who are aged, blind or disabled.
benefits.value: 2026 federal maximum $994/month individual; $1,491/month eligible couple, reduced by countable income.
benefits.income: Countable income test with exclusions; do not use one gross-income cutoff for every claimant.
benefits.assets: $2,000 individual; $3,000 couple in countable resources; exclusions include qualifying home and vehicle.
benefits.household: Couple/deeming and living-arrangement rules affect payment.
benefits.residency: Rhode Island residents, including Jamestown, subject to program criteria.
benefits.combine: RI state supplement may apply; SSI can establish automatic Extra Help eligibility. Report other income.
benefits.apply: Start SSI application through SSA.
benefits.docs: Income/resources, living arrangement, identity and disability evidence when applicable.
benefits.status_detail: Administrator publishes the program; individual availability and approval are not guaranteed.
caveats: Fields marked not published were not established in the reviewed sources; this is not proof that the administrator has no rule.

benefits.name: Medicare coverage and preventive services
benefits.admin: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services / SSA
benefits.benefit: Hospital and medical insurance; specified preventive services have no cost sharing when coverage conditions are met.
benefits.value: Coverage rather than unrestricted cash; premium and cost-sharing obligations vary.
benefits.min_age: Usually 65; disability, ALS and kidney-disease pathways can qualify earlier.
benefits.income: Basic eligibility is not means tested; premiums and assistance depend on circumstances.
benefits.residency: Rhode Island residents, including Jamestown, subject to program criteria.
benefits.combine: MSP and Extra Help can reduce costs; Medicaid may supplement Medicare.
benefits.apply: Enroll through SSA; compare coverage with SHIP.
benefits.status_detail: Administrator publishes the program; individual availability and approval are not guaranteed.
caveats: Do not assume Medicare includes routine comprehensive dental, hearing aids or eyeglasses. Verify the specific service or plan.
Enrollment timing and employer-coverage exceptions require individual review.

benefits.income: No income test for these coverage protections.

benefits.combine: Extra Help can further reduce drug costs; caps do not mean all drugs are covered.

benefits.status_detail: Administrator publishes the program; individual availability and approval are not guaranteed.
